clue.text: Young lady recalled favourite indiscretion

parts.note: a miss is a girl or young woman

indicators.note: to recall is to call back, so the word is brought back the way it came

parts.note: a teacher's pet is the favourite

explanation.surface: A young woman brought up an old sweetheart's indiscretion.
explanation.definitionFit: A misstep is a false step, figuratively a blunder or lapse of judgement.

clue.text: Mother on bed cradles son, lucky child

indicators.note: to cradle is to hold in the arms, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother
a cot is a small bed
S abbreviates son

explanation.surface: A mother cradles her son on the bed, a lucky child.
explanation.definitionFit: A mascot is a person or thing thought to bring luck, often a child leading out a sports team.

clue.text: Tin full of fish rattled

indicators.note: a vessel full of something holds it inside

parts.note: Sn is the chemical symbol for tin
hake is a sea fish

explanation.surface: A tin can stuffed with fish being rattled.
explanation.definitionFit: Shaken means upset or unnerved, the same as rattled in its informal sense.

clue.text: Remove knotted tie, say to relax

indicators.note: something knotted is twisted up, so the letters that follow are tangled

parts.note: to take away is to remove
the two words' letters mixed

explanation.surface: Advice to undo a knotted tie, say, in order to relax.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Say' looks like 'for example' but its letters join the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to stop working hard and rest or unwind.

clue.text: Parking sounded metallic, clearly an accident

parts.note: P is the road-sign symbol for parking
a bell or metal rang when struck

explanation.surface: In the car park there was a metallic noise, plainly a crash.
explanation.walkthrough: A prang is British slang for a minor collision in a car.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is informal British for a crash, especially a small car or aircraft accident.

clue.text: Daydream about face of Veronica Lake

parts.note: re means concerning or about

indicators.note: a face is the front, so only the opening letter of the next word counts

parts.note: the front letter of the name
Lake Erie, one of the North American Great Lakes

explanation.surface: Someone is lost in a daydream about the face of the 1940s film star Veronica Lake.
explanation.walkthrough: Veronica Lake looks like one name, the screen actress, but it splits: her initial, then a Great Lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A reverie is a state of pleasant, dreamy abstraction, a synonym for daydream.

clue.text: Liverpool player on NY football team stars

parts.note: Liverpool FC play in red and are called the Reds
the New York Giants play American football

explanation.surface: A Liverpool footballer signs up with a New York team of stars.
explanation.definitionFit: Red giants are large, cool, luminous stars late in their life cycle.

clue.text: Very cool grip

parts.note: V abbreviates very
to ice is to chill or cool

explanation.surface: Someone with a very cool, steady grip.
explanation.definitionFit: A vice is a bench tool with jaws that clamp and hold work firmly.

clue.text: Runny nose with some catarrh in it, I suppose

indicators.note: some means a portion, so only part of the following words is used

parts.note: the letters run on from the end of the first word into the start of the last

explanation.surface: A doctor guesses that a runny nose with catarrh in it means some infection.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhinitis is inflammation of the nasal lining, whose main symptom is a running nose.

clue.text: Child in flat finally getting service

parts.note: a flat surface is even
a son is a child

indicators.note: finally points to the end, so only the closing letter is kept

parts.note: the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: A child in a flat finally gets some help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' is loose here: the child follows the word for flat rather than going inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Evensong is the Anglican evening prayer service.

clue.text: Hot feeding fire in cabin

indicators.note: something feeding goes into the mouth of another, so one piece is put inside the other

parts.note: to fire someone is to sack them
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: Something hot is being fed to the fire inside a little cabin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fire' reads as a blaze in the hearth, but it means dismiss from a job.
explanation.definitionFit: A shack is a crude hut or small rough cabin.

clue.text: Moreish extra ingredient Charlie halves

indicators.note: to halve something is to split it in two, so the letter sits between the two halves of the other word

parts.note: an additive is an ingredient added extra to food
Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A tasty snack owes its moreishness to some extra ingredient, which halves Charlie's willpower.
explanation.definitionFit: Moreish is British slang for food so pleasant you want more, so it is close to habit-forming.

clue.text: 'I pong in bed' spoiled proposal at first

indicators.note: spoiled means ruined or messed up, so the quoted letters are scrambled

parts.note: the quoted words supply the letters

explanation.surface: Confessing to smelling in bed spoiled a romantic proposal.
explanation.walkthrough: To pong is British slang for to stink.
explanation.definitionFit: An opening bid is the first offer made in an auction, negotiation or card game.

clue.text: Waitress's income is upsetting

definitions.meaning: first meaning: gratuities left by diners
second meaning: overturns, as one does a cup

explanation.surface: A waitress complains that her pay is upsetting.
explanation.walkthrough: The verb sense is third person: she tips the jug over, she is upsetting it.
explanation.definitionFit: Gratuities are a large share of a server's earnings, and to tip over a vessel is to upset it.

clue.text: Baddie has sex with fellow cast member

parts.note: male is one of the sexes
F abbreviates fellow
an actor is a member of a cast

explanation.surface: The villain of the piece has sex with a fellow member of the cast.
explanation.definitionFit: A malefactor is a wrongdoer or criminal, a formal word for a villain.

clue.text: Bacterial decay on feet Martin treated

indicators.note: something treated has been processed or worked on, so these letters are reworked

parts.note: all twelve letters go into the mix

explanation.surface: A podiatrist treated Martin for a bacterial infection of the feet.
explanation.definitionFit: Fermentation is the chemical breakdown of a substance by bacteria or yeasts.

clue.text: Building society often making George struggle with ATM

indicators.note: to struggle is to thrash about, so the letters are thrown into disorder

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A building society often leaves George wrestling with a cash machine.
explanation.walkthrough: A building society is a British savings and mortgage lender, much like a US savings and loan.
explanation.definitionFit: The mortgagee is the lender in a home loan, a role often taken by a building society.

clue.text: Empty coach boards earlier boat

indicators.note: to board a vessel is to go on and inside it

parts.note: sooner means earlier

indicators.note: an emptied word has its insides removed, leaving only its ends

parts.note: the first and last letters of the word

explanation.surface: An empty coach boards an earlier boat, as on a car ferry.
explanation.definitionFit: A schooner is a sailing vessel with two or more masts, fore-and-aft rigged.

clue.text: Try grouse for a change, delicious

indicators.note: a change means the bird's letters are altered in order

parts.note: to have a go is to try
the bird's letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A menu suggestion: order the grouse for a change, it is delicious.
explanation.definitionFit: Gorgeous is informal for very pleasant or delightful, so it can describe tasty food.

clue.text: TV to go over sideboard

parts.note: to cross a road is to go over it
a dresser is a sideboard with shelves for dishes

explanation.surface: Instructions to move the television over onto the sideboard.
explanation.walkthrough: TV looks like a television set, which belongs on a sideboard, but it is short for transvestite.
explanation.definitionFit: TV is the dated abbreviation for transvestite, a person who wears clothes of the opposite sex.

clue.text: Single politician included by broadcaster providing insufficient coverage

indicators.note: something included by another is taken within it

parts.note: Sky is a British satellite broadcaster
I looks like the numeral one
an MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A broadcaster features a single politician, giving the story thin coverage.
explanation.walkthrough: Coverage looks like news reporting; the answer is about clothing that hides too little.
explanation.definitionFit: Skimpy clothes are revealing because they use too little fabric to cover the body.

clue.text: Hot in November with scarf on

parts.note: a stole is a long scarf worn over the shoulders
November is N in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Feeling hot in November with a scarf on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'With scarf on' puts the scarf before the letter. 'Hot' looks like warm weather; it is slang for stolen goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Hot is slang for illegally obtained, as in hot property.

clue.text: Strictly grown-ups coming over, hosting this

definitions.text: Strictly grown-ups coming over, hosting this

indicators.note: coming over suggests travelling back across, so the run of letters is read backwards
a host holds guests inside, so the letters lie within the words

parts.note: the last letter of the first word and the start of the second

explanation.surface: An adults-only party where the guests come over for this.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also describes the answer: an event strictly for grown-ups, with guests coming over.
explanation.definitionFit: An orgy is a wild party involving group sex, plainly restricted to adults.

clue.text: Ask American about tennis equipment range for teens, say

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the first two pieces face the other way

parts.note: to beg is to ask earnestly
A is a standard abbreviation for American
a racket is the strung bat used in tennis

explanation.surface: Someone is asked to quiz an American about the range of tennis gear for teenagers.
explanation.definitionFit: An age bracket is a band of ages grouped together, such as the teens, so the definition is by example.

clue.text: Be in, when stripped?

parts.note: surface reading: be at home with no clothes on
setter's reading: be in the water, which one does undressed

explanation.walkthrough: 'Be in' sounds like being at home; read it as being in the sea or tub, which you do stripped.
explanation.definitionFit: To bathe is to immerse oneself in water, to swim or wash.

clue.text: Short fold that's pressed in suit

indicators.note: short means cut off, so the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a pleat is a fold in cloth

explanation.surface: A short fold that has been pressed into a suit.
explanation.walkthrough: Pleats and pressing point to tailoring, but the suit is a lawsuit.
explanation.definitionFit: A plea is a defendant's formal answer put forward, or pressed, in a court case.

clue.text: Gas lamp Elon adjusted in the dark

indicators.note: something adjusted has been altered, so the name is rearranged
in places the rearranged name inside the following phrase

parts.note: night is the dark part of the day
the name's letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Elon Musk fiddles with a gas lamp in the dark.
explanation.walkthrough: The rearranged name sits after the first letter of the dark time of day.
explanation.definitionFit: A neon light is a tube lamp glowing from the noble gas neon inside it.

clue.text: Indian motorway has queue on both sides

indicators.note: something on both sides flanks the middle, so the line wraps around the road letter

parts.note: a tail is a line of waiting people or vehicles
M stands for motorway, as in the M1

explanation.surface: An Indian motorway with traffic queuing on either side.
explanation.definitionFit: A Tamil is a member of a people of southern India and Sri Lanka, or their language.

clue.text: Others took present again

parts.note: the rest are the others
to eat is to take food, so took can be ate

explanation.surface: Other people took the present back again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Present' looks like a gift noun; it is a verb meaning set out, as an argument.
explanation.definitionFit: To restate is to set out or express a point once more.

clue.text: English aggressor's outside French city before long

parts.note: E abbreviates English

indicators.note: the outside of a word is its two ends, so only the end letters are taken

parts.note: the first and last letters of the word
Lyon is France's third city

explanation.surface: An English aggressor stands outside a French city before long.
explanation.definitionFit: Early on means at an early stage, soon after the start, so near in time.
